messages.subject: RE: Jake Essex for Loxford Social Club?
messages.body:
Hi Natalie,

Thank you for your email.

We had Jake perform here over the summer, and it was lovely to have him with us.

We've always arranged our entertainment through Choice, as our entertainment secretary has built a brilliant relationship with both Darren and Laura over the years.

As Choice looks after all our entertainment bookings, any future bookings for Jake would naturally be arranged through them as well.

Thanks again for getting in touch. We really appreciate you thinking of us, and I hope you understand.

Kind regards,

Olivia Rudge
Office Administrator
Loxford Social Club

messages.subject: Re: RE: Jake Essex for Loxford Social Club?
messages.body:
Hi Olivia,

Thank you for your kind reply, and please accept my apologies. My emails to Loxford were sent in error. Loxford is a Choice venue and should never have been on my list, and Jake will be quite frustrated with me for reaching out.

Jake would never look to take work away from Choice. Darren and Laura are great and he really values working with them, so please carry on booking him through Choice exactly as you do now.

I'm so glad the club enjoyed having him over the summer, and sorry again for the mix up.

Kind regards,
Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
